_comment: Jefe mock input. Each lineItem = one spoken line: board gets an ITEM row (work) + one PRICE row per material figure; the estimate gets one priced line per material and one labor line. rate=null => labor is an honest gap (NOT HEARD), never invented. Set rate (dollars/hour) to price it.
summary: Restoration: M20 engine rebuild, 325iS five-speed swap, bodywork and paint, undercarriage, and interior.
scope: Rebuild an M20 engine from a 325iS with new pistons, rods, head gasket and bearings, and fit a 325iS five-speed manual transmission. Work, sandblast and paint the body, and redo the undercarriage: drive shaft, differential and suspension. Finish the interior with seats, dashboard and steering wheel, plus the touch-up items.

notes.label: Engine: M20 from a 325iS
notes.detail: Rebuild with pistons, rods, head gasket and bearings.

lineItems.said: rebuild this M20 motor from a 325IS. Pistons, rods, head gasket, bearings. It's going to be about $1200 in materials and 20 hours of work.
lineItems.work: Rebuild M20 motor from a 325iS, 20 hours

lineItems.said: replace the transmission with a 325IS manual 5 speed and that's going to be a $800 transmission and about 6 hours of labor.
for the body it's going to need to be worked, sandblasted and painted. And the total labor on that will be about 40 hours of labor and $2500 in materials.
lineItems.work: Body: work, sandblast and paint, 40 hours

lineItems.said: underneath the vehicle we have the drive shaft, we have the differential, all the suspension. And for undercarriage we're talking $3000 in materials and about 40 hours of labor
for all the touch up items and interior it's going to be $500 in seats. It's going to be $1200 in dashboard and steering wheel. And it's going to take me 65 hours to do the interior.
